name: Collaborative whiteboard with native document editing and agentic LLM

mentions.name: Collaborative whiteboard with native document editing and agentic LLM
mentions.description: A collaborative whiteboard where anyone or a team can drag-and-drop items from their devices onto a shared canvas that opens and edits many file types (images, xlsx, pdf, docx, cad), including native rendering and direct editing of docx and pdf files without dedicated software. It includes a built-in Drive for storing and backing up files that syncs across devices, widgets such as Kanban, sticky notes and cards, and an agentic LLM (Gemini 3 Pro) that can view the board, read documents on it, edit items, write spec sheets in docx, and create tickets on a kanban. A private beta is launching next month with testers invited to give feedback.
mentions.audience: On a team, people and their files are scattered everywhere.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on brand new type of collaborative whiteboard that allows anyone (or team) to drag-n-drop items from their devices onto the board.
